title: Streamflix
tagline: A decentralized gaming & live streaming platform that operates on a decentralized network, providing secure & transparent user experience without intermediaries, giving more control over data & assets
description: We have built a decentralized game and live stream website that we have named Streamflix. Our platform leverages the power of decentralization to provide a secure and transparent experience for users. The live streaming aspect of the platform is powered by the Livepeer protocol, which allows for high-quality and efficient video streams without the need for central authority. The platform is also deployed on the Spheron protocol, adding another layer of security and decentralization to the system. By using these cutting-edge technologies, Streamflix aims to create a new standard in the world of online gaming and live streaming. With no intermediaries and complete control over their data and assets, users can experience a new level of freedom and security in their online interactions.
how_its_made:
The motivation behind building Streamflix, a decentralized game and live stream website, is to provide users with a secure and transparent platform for gaming and live streaming. The centralization of traditional gaming and live streaming platforms has led to concerns about data privacy, user control over assets, and the potential for censorship. To address these issues, we decided to create a decentralized platform that operates on a decentralized network, allowing for a more secure and transparent experience for users.

Streamflix is powered by the Livepeer protocol for live streaming and is deployed on the Spheron protocol, providing an extra layer of security and decentralization. By using these advanced technologies, we aim to create a new standard in the world of online gaming and live streaming. The platform operates on a peer-to-peer network, eliminating the need for intermediaries and giving users complete control over their data and assets. With no central authority, users can experience a new level of freedom and security in their online interactions.
